d:
How deep can a watch go? From the Rolex Oyster of 1926 to modern watches engineered to withstand the crushing pressure 11 kilometres underwater, watchmakers have spent a century pushing the limits of water resistance. In this episode of The Spend, we explore the evolution of waterproof watches, the extraordinary engineering behind them, and why brands continue to push the limits far beyond what any human diver could survive.
